'You may banish an attack action card from your hand. If you do, IT gets +3{p} or go again until end of turn.'

BOTH BRANCHES BUFFED THE WRONG CARD. 'It' is the card just banished -- Talishar pins the effect to that object's unique id and applies it when that card is PLAYED -- and neither queue was pinned to anything. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK matched on properties, so the +3 landed on whichever attack was played next; GRANT_KEYWORD_TO_PLAYED is worse, because by its own docstring it covers EVERY matching card for the rest of the turn rather than one, so the 'go again' branch handed out an unprinted keyword repeatedly.

The attack queue now pins by object_id the way dsl_queued_card_mods already did ('your next attack WITH IT'), and the go-again branch uses MODIFY_NEXT_CARD, which is the played-card queue and already supported object_ref.

Go again is PRINTED on this card and granted by the card DB; the JSON also carried a GO_AGAIN effect, a second copy of a keyword CR 8.3.5b says an object cannot have twice.

The unread 'uses': 1 is gone -- one use is the default.
